title: Employ only licensed casino staff
what: Have casino key employees and casino employees work only while holding the licence for their role.

sources.title: Casino Control Act 1982 (Qld)
sources.quote: A person shall not work as or be a casino key employee or a casino employee unless— (a) in the case of a casino key employee—the person is the holder of a casino key employee licence and in the case of a casino employee the person is the holder of a casino employee licence
